_about: Quarterly results transcribed BY READING the companies' own SEBI Reg. 33 results statements (PDF page images) for three Nifty 500 names that file only with BSE and are merely 'permitted to trade' on NSE, so NSE carries no results for them. Transcribed 2026-09-25. Values are exactly as printed, in the statement's own unit (field 'unit'); pipeline/results.py converts to Rs crore and runs the gates (EPS x shares vs PAT to owners; every 'confirm' document must show the same figures). PDFs are cached in cache/results_raw/company_pdf/. Sources: Abbott = the company's own investor-relations PDFs. Bayer and MCX = the same filed statements as hosted on BSE's attachment server, because bayer.in and mcxindia.com refuse automated requests (bot blocks, not bypassed).
